trained_on: all available labeled windows (data/processed/g3_features.parquet), not held out
fall_threshold_calibration: Evaluation-bound legacy DEVELOPMENT policy only. Threshold 0.50 is bound to artifacts/evaluations/rf-sensing-falls-v3-oof-transient-2026-08-07.json: recall=0.170213, specificity=0.916667, PPV=0.235294 on 359 pooled leave-one-day/geometry-out transient windows (47 falls). It failed acceptance criteria and is not an independent calibration. The former threshold 0.0004 is explicitly invalid and prohibited because its full-population sweep did not match the transient-only serving path.
calibration_note: Neither stage output nor the combined fall score is a calibrated probability. The threshold is a frozen offline-baseline decision policy, not evidence of deployment calibration.
onnx_output_note: The ONNX-exported models' "probabilities" output is RAW PRE-SOFTMAX SCORES, not normalized probabilities, despite the output name -- verified 2026-07-31 by comparing against native XGBoost predict_proba() (which IS correctly normalized) on identical inputs: applying softmax manually to the ONNX raw output matches native predict_proba to within 2e-7. Any inference code consuming these ONNX models MUST apply softmax explicitly to the "probabilities" output before using it as an actual probability (e.g. for the fall_decision_threshold comparison below) -- this is an onnxmltools conversion quirk for the multi:softmax XGBoost objective, not a modeling bug.
